scoring.edge_definition: Percentage-point probability minus price break-even, with pushes excluded. Props: unknown edge, numerical component zero, missing-model penalty 4. ML penalty 12 for tail/settlement sensitivity. Contest threshold 50% is a neutral comparison, not a cash break-even.
scoring.scales: Consensus and price -2 to +2; news 0 to 3. Consensus is an analyst rubric after discounting duplicate/stale leads, not a raw speaker count. Correlation -0.5 for totals, zero otherwise before explicit portfolio constraints.
scoring.price_score_definition: Publish-time availability/price quality, not an extra model probability; line advantage is already in fixed-distribution edge. Negative for moved-away analyst lines.
scoring.ties: Lower news risk, then stable id for equally robust captures. Stafford and Tucker score ties are not evidence of a meaningful rank difference.
scoring.candidate_scope: All two-sided spreads, totals and moneylines on BKR and parsed BEO game_lines, plus five sourced priced prop leads; both locked contest sides per game. Not an exhaustive search over thousands of unsupported prop ladders.
scoring.contest_ranking: Rank the five locked-line choices by conditional expected contest points (win + half push); use the displayed cash-style composite only as a tie-breaker. This preserves the large contest line advantages instead of letting capped edge scoring obscure them.
